name: Inkdrop

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia World Guide

items.name: Perfect Memory
items.text: An inkdrop remembers the exact pattern of any ink it moves over physically.

items.name: Blotting
items.text: While a creature has the inkdrop grabbed or pinned, it can destroy the inkdrop by smudging the inkdrop out with an Interact action.

items.name: Blinding Ink
items.text: A creature critically struck by the inkdrop's pseudopod is Blinded by the ink until it clears its eyes using an Interact action.

items.name: Ink Blot
items.text: The inkdrop leaves a pattern it remembers over a square foot of surface. If there's existing non-magical ink on the surface, the inkdrop erases the nonmagical ink.

text: Not all handcrafts are intended for war. The inkdrop is an infiltrator used by spellcasters to learn secrets or alter documents. Embodied in a single fist-sized drop of ink, the inkdrop can glide across a page, changing characters or removing them altogether, with devastating consequences for statecraft.
